column1: # NekoRPG location reconcile — zh <TAB> en <TAB> note.  Source: NekoRPG/src/locations.js
# FINDING: 57 distinct base locations; 50 already in Script.txt #location_actions_div block.
# Combat sub-zones (BaseName - 1/2/X/XL/I-IV/∞ ...) inherit automatically via the script's
# substring matcher — no per-zone entries needed. Only the 7 bases below were missing.
# ⚠️ ORDERING: each of these is a SUBSTRING of longer entries already in the dict
#   (地宫 ⊂ 地宫入口/地宫核心; 地宫核心 ⊂ 地宫核心 - 悬空平台; 幻境核心 ⊂ 幻境核心·地宫; etc).
#   The script applies every matching pair per text node, so these MUST be appended AFTER
#   all more-specific location entries, or they corrupt them (Crypt入口 bug). Order within
#   this list also matters: 地宫核心 before bare 地宫.
